interpretation: TALA's official claims corpus, fully processed through the claim-evidence fusion pipeline.
mandatory_caveat: Claims are official brand statements collected from public sources; not a random sample of all possible claims.

interpretation: 14 of 37 claims (37.8%) have supporting evidence outweighing challenging evidence per the automated fusion rule.
mandatory_caveat: 'Aligned' means the automated rule found net-supporting evidence, not that the claim was independently proven true.

interpretation: 5 of 37 claims (13.5%) have both supporting and challenging evidence of comparable strength.
mandatory_caveat: 'Mixed' does not automatically indicate greenwashing; it flags a claim needing human review of the specific tension.

interpretation: 18 of 37 claims (48.6%) -- the largest single group -- have no evidence unit meeting the relevance/strength threshold.
mandatory_caveat: 'Insufficient evidence' means unvalidated, not false. It must never be presented as a contradiction or a negative finding about the claim's truth.

interpretation: No claim in this corpus received the strongest divergence label under current evidence and thresholds.
mandatory_caveat: Absence of divergent claims reflects the current evidence corpus, particularly weak/zero independent evidence for many categories, not proof that no divergence exists.

metric_value: labour 14; manufacturing 8; materials 7; other 5; circularity 1; emissions 1; packaging 1
interpretation: Labour claims are the single largest category (37.8% of all claims) and, per F013, carry zero independent evidence.
mandatory_caveat: Category sizes reflect what TALA published and what the team could collect, not the relative business importance of each theme.

metric_name: Total evidence units linked to claims
interpretation: 119 distinct evidence units (customer review, press, official reference, image, video) were matched to claims for fusion.
mandatory_caveat: Evidence units are unevenly distributed; some claims have many, 18 claims have zero usable evidence beyond the claim itself.

interpretation: Text evidence (customer reviews, press, official claims) dominates; image/video evidence is present only for visually-groundable claim categories.
mandatory_caveat: Video/image evidence units are frame-summary or product-image evidence, not independent proof of the underlying claim.

metric_value: customer_review 46; official_claim 37; official_reference 16; press 10; official_video 7; official_product_image 3
interpretation: Customer reviews are the largest independent-ish evidence source; official_claim rows are the claims corpus itself, included as self-reported context.
mandatory_caveat: official_claim and official_reference rows are brand self-reported sources, not independent verification.

interpretation: Only 3 claims (all visually-groundable categories such as materials/packaging) have any linked image evidence.
mandatory_caveat: Image evidence supports appearance/material claims only; it cannot corroborate labour, emissions, or process claims.

interpretation: 7 claims have linked video-derived evidence (frame/temporal features or transcript-adjacent summary), all in visually-groundable categories.
mandatory_caveat: Video evidence here is genuinely processed (sampled frames / temporal features, see F040-F041), not a URL or engagement statistic.

interpretation: 16 claims are linked to enterprise reference documents (impact reports, certifications, sizing/fabric-care guidance, policies).
mandatory_caveat: Reference documents are brand-published; they corroborate claim wording, not independent third-party validation.

interpretation: Just over half of all claims (19/37) have at least one independently-sourced (non-brand) evidence unit.
mandatory_caveat: The remaining 18 claims rely solely on self-reported/brand-authored evidence, and are concentrated in labour and packaging/emissions categories.

metric_name: Claims with a full multimodal evidence bundle (text+image+video+reference)
interpretation: Only 3 claims currently have evidence spanning all four modalities simultaneously.
mandatory_caveat: Full multimodal bundles are the exception, not the norm, in this corpus -- most claims rely on 1-2 modalities.

metric_name: Claims flagged sensitive to fusion-weight changes
interpretation: 15 claims' automated label could change under alternative, still-reasonable fusion weight configurations (per sensitivity analysis).
mandatory_caveat: Weight-sensitive claims should be flagged for human review before external presentation; their label is not fully stable.

metric_name: Claims with a flagged evidence conflict
interpretation: 5 claims have directly conflicting supporting vs. challenging evidence units, corresponding to the 'mixed' label group.
mandatory_caveat: Conflict is a structural evidence property, not an accusation; each requires case-by-case review (see mixed-claim theme summary).

interpretation: 5 individual claim records carry the 'mixed' automated label.
mandatory_caveat: These 5 records consolidate into only 2 underlying themes (F018) -- they are not 5 independent problems.

interpretation: The 5 mixed claim records reduce to 2 distinct themes: (1) brand mission/conscious-value positioning, (2) tier-3 supplier/material-innovation collaboration claims.
mandatory_caveat: Consolidating into themes avoids over-counting a single underlying tension as multiple separate findings.

interpretation: 18 claims (all 14 labour claims, plus packaging, emissions, and 2 'other') have no evidence unit clearing the relevance/strength threshold.
mandatory_caveat: Insufficient evidence is the dominant outcome for this corpus and must be presented as an evidence-gap finding only, per presentation_restriction policy.

interpretation: Labour is the single largest claim category (37.8% of all claims).
mandatory_caveat: All 14 labour claims relate to the Washing Machine Project social-enterprise partnership as published by TALA.

interpretation: None of the 14 labour claims have any independently-sourced evidence in the current corpus; all rely solely on TALA's own statements.
mandatory_caveat: This is a stated evidence gap, not a finding that the labour claims are false or that TALA is greenwashing.

interpretation: 61 creator/platform records were collected across TALA and 3 competitors for descriptive comparison.
mandatory_caveat: This is a targeted, non-random sample (largely YouTube), not a statistically representative sample of each brand's full creator activity.

metric_value: TALA 24; Adanola 16; Girlfriend Collective 13; Oner Active 8
interpretation: TALA has the largest and most varied sample; Oner Active has the smallest sample and requires cautious interpretation.
mandatory_caveat: Denominators differ by brand and are never merged into a single combined percentage; comparisons must always be brand-relative.

interpretation: The corpus is almost entirely YouTube-sourced (60/61 records).
mandatory_caveat: Findings from this corpus are YouTube-dominated and must not be generalised to Instagram/TikTok creator strategy without saying so explicitly.

metric_value: TALA organic 62.5%; Adanola paid_sponsorship 50.0%; Girlfriend Collective affiliate 61.5%; Oner Active organic 87.5%
interpretation: TALA and Oner Active lean organic/unpaid; Adanola leans heavily paid; Girlfriend Collective leans affiliate.
mandatory_caveat: Percentages are within-brand only; do not compare raw counts across brands with different denominators.

metric_value: TALA product_demonstration 75.0%; Adanola product_demonstration 100.0%; Girlfriend Collective product_demonstration 46.2% / mixed 30.8%; Oner Active product_demonstration 50.0% / mixed 37.5%
interpretation: Product demonstration dominates every brand's creator content; only TALA and Girlfriend Collective show any responsibility-themed creator content.
mandatory_caveat: 'Mixed' intent content should not be read as evidence quality; it describes editorial mix only, and this is descriptive, not predictive of engagement.

interpretation: The RAG index holds 37 claim records, 662 text-evidence chunks, and 76 visual-evidence (image/video-frame) records.
mandatory_caveat: Index size reflects what was collected and chunked; it is not a completeness guarantee across all possible TALA claims or evidence.

interpretation: No duplicate IDs exist in any of the 3 Chroma collections.
Every visual-evidence record in the index resolves to a locally present asset file; none were rejected for a missing file.

population_or_denominator: n=21 claims with linked text/reference evidence
interpretation: For 76.2% of evaluated claims, the text retriever surfaces at least one of the claim's known-linked evidence units within its top 10 results.
mandatory_caveat: Evaluated on 21 of 37 claims that actually have a linked text/reference evidence unit to test against; not all 37 claims are represented in this metric.

interpretation: The mean reciprocal rank of 0.199 indicates the correct evidence unit is typically not ranked first, though it is usually retrieved within the top 10 (per F030).
mandatory_caveat: A modest MRR is expected at this corpus scale; it should be reported honestly alongside recall@10, not in isolation.

interpretation: Every claim was routed to image/video retrieval if and only if its category is authoritatively defined as visually groundable.
mandatory_caveat: This is a deterministic rule-based routing check, not a machine-learning classifier accuracy metric.

metric_name: Citation-validation pass rate on demo cases
interpretation: All 3 documented demo generations (text+image+video claim, mixed-claim explanation, insufficient-evidence explanation) passed automated citation validation: citations exist in retrieved context, referenced assets resolve, and the production fusion label was preserved.
mandatory_caveat: This validates 3 fixed, documented demo cases, not continuous production monitoring of every possible query.

interpretation: All structural readiness gates (integrity, retrieval, routing, demo cases, citation validation, no-fallback, no-engagement-prediction, no human-labelling dependency) read GO.
mandatory_caveat: GO status reflects structural/automated checks completed in this development session; it is not an external audit or production monitoring result.

interpretation: 26 distinct risk scenarios are catalogued across data, privacy, media rights, model, evidence, citation, ESG, oversight, security, vendor, incident, monitoring and training domains.
mandatory_caveat: The register is a point-in-time identification exercise for an academic prototype, not a certified enterprise risk assessment.

interpretation: Before any mitigating controls, 11 of 26 risks (High + Critical) are rated at the top of the severity scale.
Existing controls reduce the Critical/High count from 11 to 1, but the majority of risks remain at Medium residual severity.
mandatory_caveat: Residual ratings assume the documented controls are actually operating; several are 'Proposed' rather than fully implemented (see F038).

interpretation: 71% of catalogued controls (37/52) are already implemented in the current codebase; 15 are proposed or partially implemented.
mandatory_caveat: 'Implemented' means present in this codebase/prototype, not independently audited or enterprise-certified.

metric_value: Academic demonstration: 13/13 gates GO; Controlled internal pilot: 13/13 gates PARTIAL; External customer-facing: 13/13 gates NO-GO
population_or_denominator: n=13 governance gates x 3 deployment contexts
source_columns_or_filter: cross-tab of gate x deployment_context x status
interpretation: The system is fully ready for academic demonstration, requires Phase 1-2 work for an internal pilot, and is explicitly NOT ready for external customer-facing deployment on every gate.
mandatory_caveat: This verdict must be stated in the deck exactly as NO-GO for external use -- do not soften this to 'in progress' or 'nearly ready'.

population_or_denominator: n=61 total video leads across 4 brands
interpretation: Only 8 TALA videos (0 for any competitor) have genuine temporal processing: multiple sampled frames and temporal features. All 61 records started as video leads (URL/title/thumbnail/metadata only).
mandatory_caveat: The other 53 video leads (16 Adanola, 13 Girlfriend Collective, 8 Oner Active, 16 additional TALA) are platform-metadata-only and must be labelled rights_or_access_basis=platform_metadata_only, never counted as processed video coverage.

metric_value: 52 total sampled frames across 8 processed videos (mean 6.5 frames/video); 8 of 8 with temporal features; 0 of 8 with transcript
interpretation: The 8 processed TALA videos have real multi-frame sampling and motion/temporal features, satisfying the binding video-processing definition; no transcript evidence trail exists yet for any video.
mandatory_caveat: Transcript coverage is 0% -- this is a genuine gap to disclose, not to paper over with frame-only evidence presented as a full transcript-backed analysis.
